name: Issue 3406: Master of Runes cuts Rune-spell cooldowns by the tooltip's 25%
contract: 804531 is a native SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER aura (AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:173)
on SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (misc=11), EffectBasePoints[0]=-26 (displayed -25%, matching the tooltip's 25%
SpellFamilyFlags[0]=0x1000000 overlaps classmask0, so it is affected. Silencing Rune's Spell.dbc
RecoveryTime is 90000ms. SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN is applied generically at spell-cast cooldown calculation
Verification notes: (1) Silencing Rune's CastingTimeIndex 16 resolves to a real 1500ms cast time
(SpellCastTimes.dbc) - the cooldown is only registered once the cast finishes (Spell::SendSpellCooldown,
called from _handle_finish_phase), so both cooldown_ms reads need a retry window past 1500ms, not an
immediate single check. (2) 802631 also has its own StartRecoveryCategory 133 / StartRecoveryTime 1000ms
(a 1s GCD) - reset_cooldown only clears the plain per-spell cooldown entry, not this GCD, so the second
cast needs to wait out the GCD from the first cast before it will be accepted.

steps.label: SETUP: base Silencing Rune cooldown matches the DBC's 90000ms
Let the 1s GCD from the first cast expire
CONTRACT: cooldown is reduced ~25% with Master of Runes
